answer: Proof of Burn mechanisms effectively resist Sybil attacks by requiring agents to permanently destroy native tokens to secure participation rights. This creates an economic barrier that prevents any malicious node from attempting to harbor multiple fraudulent identities, as the cost of capital outweighs the potential gains. Like a willow bending under immense pressure, the network remains resilient against volume-based infiltration. Each validated identity is as distinct as an opal, ensuring that only stake-backed entities participate.
